units.text: अपने आयुर्वेदिक कार्यक्रम की योजना बनाएँ | Kairali
units.issue: The full brand suffix 'Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village' was shortened to 'Kairali' to keep the SEO title under 60 characters. The full Hindi title with the complete brand name would be about 82 characters.

units.text: Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village: National Geographic Traveler का 'एशिया का शीर्ष दस वेलनेस गंतव्य'; आयुर्वेदिक वेलनेस हेतु अंतरराष्ट्रीय मान्यता।
units.issue: Rendered concisely to stay within 155 characters (about 153). The 'recipient of' meaning is carried by 'मान्यता' rather than the longer 'मान्यता प्राप्त'.
